blocks.prompt: 17 Find the general solution of the differential equation \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = x e^{-y/x} + y\).
blocks.explanation:
Agar poori equation ko \(x\) se divide karein to \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{-y/x} + \frac{y}{x}\) milta hai.
Ab right side sirf \(y/x\) par depend karti hai, is liye equation homogeneous hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = xe^{-y/x} + y\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\) rakhna; \(v\) cancel ho jayega aur \(e^{v}\) ka integral bilkul aasaan hai.
Plan: \(x\) se divide, \(y = vx\), variables alag, integrate, \(v\) wapas.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = xe^{-y/x} + y\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation: \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\).

\(x\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = e^{-y/x} + \dfrac{y}{x}\]
Kyun: Is shakal mein saaf nazar aata hai ke right side sirf \(y/x\) ka function hai; yahi homogeneous hone ki pehchaan hai.

\(y = vx\) rakhein
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = e^{-v} + v\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = e^{-v}\]
Kyun: \(e^{-y/x}\) mein \(y/x = v\) rakha to \(e^{-v}\) bana. Dono taraf ka \(v\) cancel ho gaya.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dv}{e^{-v}} = \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
\[e^{v}\,dv = \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
Kyun: \(e^{-v}\) se divide kiya; aur \(\frac{1}{e^{-v}} = e^{v}\) kyunke negative power denominator se upar aa kar positive ho jati hai.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{-v}\) ko \(dv\) ke saath multiply mat kijiye; usay divide karna hai, warna integral ulta aa jayega.

Integrate karein
\[e^{v} = \ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
\[e^{v} = \ln|Cx|\]
Kyun: \(e^{v}\) ka integral wohi \(e^{v}\) hai, aur \(\frac{1}{x}\) ka integral \(\ln|x|\). Constant ko \(\ln|C|\) likh kar dono log mila diye.

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[e^{y/x} = \ln|Cx|\]
Kyun: Jawab \(x\) aur \(y\) mein dena hai.

Tasdeeq
Differentiate karein: \(e^{y/x}\,\dfrac{xy' - y}{x^2} = \dfrac{1}{x}\), is liye
\[xy' - y = xe^{-y/x}\]
Yeh di hui equation hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Chain rule se \(e^{y/x}\) ka derivative \(e^{y/x}\) times \((y/x)'\) hai. Phir dono taraf \(x^2e^{-y/x}\) se multiply kiya to asal equation wapas mil gayi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 20 par chhapa hai, 17 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 20 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(e^{y/x} = \ln|Cx|\), sahi hai.
